notes.title: Hand in Hand now has a remote co-operative mode
notes.notes:
Looking for a game that will challenge your skills, test your teamwork and touch your heart? Then check out Hand In Hand, a 2D split-screen puzzle platformer that tells the story of two soul mates who must find each other in a fairytale world overrun by evil shadows.


Hand In Hand is a unique split-screen game where each screen has one character on its half of the screen. You can play in single player mode, where you control both characters with one device, or in local co-op mode, where you and a friend can play together on the same device. What's more, we've released an update that allows you to play the game co-operatively from different accounts and different devices that are far away from each other. Each mode has its own rewards and challenges, requiring you to coordinate your movements, solve puzzles and help each other complete levels.


The game features a variety of locations, such as fairytale forests, ancient ruins, labyrinths and caves, where you will face various obstacles and dangers. There are also epic boss battles where each character must defeat their shadow boss. The game has a beautiful ethnic style, an exciting soundtrack and a heartwarming story that will make you feel the importance of relationships and mutual support.


Hand In Hand is currently running an introductory offer. Don't miss your chance to get this great game at a reduced price. If you're interested, you can visit the game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209510/Hand_In_Hand/]Steam page[/url] and see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1209510/reviews/?browsefilter=toprated&snr=1_5_100010_#scrollTop=0]what other players and curators are saying about it[/url]. You can also watch the trailer [previewyoutube=61klG6O2Zp8;full][here][/previewyoutube] and see the game in action. Hand In Hand is a game that will make you smile, cry and cheer as you embark on a journey of love and friendship. Buy it now and see for yourself!

notes.title: Hand in Hand: A Split Screen Puzzle Platformer Game Is Available Now on Steam
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=61klG6O2Zp8;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you looking for a new game to play with your partner or friend? Do you like unusual puzzle platformers? Do you enjoy games that tell a heartwarming story of love, loss, and hope? If you answered yes to any of these questions, then you'll love Hand in Hand, a new game now available on Steam.

Hand in Hand is a game that involves two kindred spirits living in a fairy tale world. But when evil came into their world, they lost each other. Now they both need to meet each other halfway, encountering many difficulties and dangers along the way. And only by finding a fragile connection between them and walking hand in hand, will they be able to defeat evil and meet again.

Hand in Hand is a game that uses a split-screen mechanic, with each character occupying a different position on each screen. You can play the game in two modes: solo or co-op. In single player mode, you control both characters with a single joystick, requiring a high level of skill and reflexes. In co-op mode, you play with a friend or partner on the same device, each controlling one character using their own joystick. In both modes, you need to communicate and cooperate with each other to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles.

Hand in Hand is a game that offers many challenges and surprises. Exciting boss battles await you, where you will have to face the evil shadows that have invaded the fairy-tale world. You will also explore different environments such as forests, caves, ruins and more. You will also learn the story of two soulmates and how important their relationship and mutual support are.

Hand in Hand is a game that will make you cry and smile at the same time. It's a game that combines puzzle solving, platforming, and split-screen mechanics in a creative and fun way. This is a game with beautiful graphics and music, as well as an exciting atmosphere. This is a game that you will enjoy playing with your partner or friend or even alone.

If you are interested in Hand in Hand, you can follow the link in the description below. You can also watch the trailer, read reviews and see screenshots of the game. Hand in Hand is a game not to be missed. Download it now on Steam and enjoy the adventure.

notes.title: The full release of the Hand In Hand game will take place on November 30!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37047744/78eb3f630f5e9bfbe21c9619a5f80429efc3ab52.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Hey everyone![/b]

Do you have the heart for a grand adventure? Do you have the agility to control two souls bound by fragile ties? Fear not, brave player, for OverGamez and MaxMedia are pleased to bring you "Hand In Hand", an enchanting split-screen puzzle platformer that is nearing a full release on Steam on November 30th, 2023! Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209510/Hand_In_Hand/]Hand In Hand[/url]

Embark on a journey through a fairytale world ravaged by the shadows of evil, where the courage to seek unity will be your greatest asset. Control Linna and Enho, two soul mates separated by the invading darkness that has taken over their beloved homeland. Work and solve puzzles side-by-side while engaging in atmospheric exploration in a split-screen co-op mode where success comes from mutual aid.

Battle the epic bosses that populate the tormented forest, each symbolizing an all-consuming shadow that corrupts the world. In battles that test your stamina and wits, heroes will have to fight both alone and together. 

While single players will enjoy deftly controlling two characters at once, don't forget to make room for your comrade on the couch in Local Co-op mode! Colossal obstacles, thrilling boss battles and tricky puzzles await those willing to lend a hand in this exciting odyssey.

Act fast, because October 30th is the last opportunity to play Hand In Hand demo on Steam. Don't be deterred by the brevity of the demo. We promise that the pleasure that awaits you in the full version is worth every moment of waiting.

Victory is already in your hands, will you take it in your own hands? November 30 is the date of destiny that awaits you and the brave souls of Linna and Enho.

Be sure [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209510/Hand_In_Hand/]to add the game to your wishlist[/url] so you don't miss the release!

notes.title: Hand in Hand Set to Sparkle at Steam's Next Fest with Live Game Broadcasts
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ci9HtPdSAWk;full][/previewyoutube]

Brace yourself for an unforgettable journey as Hand in Hand, a deeply immersive and atmospheric puzzle-platformer game, prepares its grand showcase at the highly anticipated Steam's Next Fest. In a world where gaming intersects with the arts, Hand in Hand stands out with its unique split-screen co-op mode and enchanting storyline – making it one of the most sought after games in this year's festival lineup.

Steam's Next Fest, an online celebration of upcoming games, offers an unprecedented chance to dive deep into exciting new releases and future bestsellers. Hand in Hand, renowned for its split-screen gameplay and fascinating narrative, is thrilled to be part of the lineup and is all set to provide an unforgettable gaming experience to fans globally.

To make things even more exciting, this year’s participation will be accompanied by a live broadcast of Hand in Hand’s gameplay. The broadcast will be held on September 11th, 2023 at 01:00 (UTC+3). This is the perfect opportunity to join our heroes, Linna and Enho, as they navigate through fascinating levels, overcoming intricate puzzles, and shady bosses in their mission to reunite in their fantastical forest home.

Hand in Hand is more than just a game, it's a statement about unity, conjunction, and enduring support in a captivating ethnic world plagued by impending darkness. Each quest, each step taken by our duo, melds into an ethereal gaming experience that draws in the player, engulfing them in a cosmos of mystery, adventure, and unrivaled camaraderie.

Join us during the live broadcasts to see this beautifully crafted tale come to life within the realms of Steam's Next Fest platform. Journey with us as we step into a world where teamwork and puzzle-solving reign supreme. Experience the joy of playing Hand in Hand and immerse yourself in the power of cooperative gameplay, lending a unique edge to our participation in this year's festival.

Get ready to be taken on a journey of unity, love, mystery, and exhilaration during the live broadcast. Don't miss this chance to be part of the story where two heroes save an enchanted world, Hand in Hand.

Gear up, mark your calendars, and stay tuned for further updates as we make our mark at Steam's Next Fest in the most intriguing way possible!
